materials.name: Brickwork, outer leaf (exposed)
materials.notes: Conventional UK design value for an exposed outer leaf. Check against BR 443 and CIBSE Guide A Table 3.49; ISO 10456 gives masonry by density band rather than by UK leaf convention.

materials.name: Brickwork, inner leaf (protected)
materials.notes: Conventional UK design value for a protected inner leaf. Check against BR 443 and CIBSE Guide A Table 3.49.

materials.name: Dense aggregate concrete block
materials.notes: Generic UK dense aggregate block. Product values vary widely; check against BR 443 and manufacturer declared values, and confirm mu against ISO 10456 Table 3.

materials.name: Aircrete (autoclaved aerated) block
materials.notes: Generic UK aircrete block. UK products span roughly 0.11 to 0.20 W/(m*K) by density; check against BR 443 and manufacturer declared values.

materials.name: Concrete, medium density
materials.notes: Check lambda, c and mu against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3, which tabulates concrete by density.

materials.name: Concrete, reinforced (1 % steel)
materials.notes: Check against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3, which lists reinforced concrete separately by steel content.

materials.name: Gypsum plasterboard
materials.notes: Check lambda, rho, c and mu against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3 (gypsum plasterboard, 900 kg/m3).

materials.name: Gypsum plaster, dense
materials.notes: Check against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3, which tabulates gypsum plaster by density.

materials.name: Cement:sand render
materials.notes: Check against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3 (cement mortar / plaster) and BR 443.

materials.name: Sand:cement screed
materials.notes: Check against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3 and BR 443.

materials.name: Softwood, structural
materials.notes: Check against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3 (softwood, 500 kg/m3), including whether the dry (50) or wet (20) mu applies for the intended use.

materials.name: Oriented strand board (OSB)
materials.notes: Check lambda, rho, c and mu against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3 (OSB) and BS EN 13986.

materials.name: Plywood
materials.notes: Check against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3 (plywood by density) and BS EN 13986.

materials.name: Chipboard flooring
materials.notes: Check against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3 (particleboard by density) and BS EN 13986.

materials.name: Mineral wool quilt
materials.notes: Generic value only; lambda is product-specific and declared to BS EN 13162. Check c and mu against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3 (mineral wool).

materials.name: Expanded polystyrene (EPS) board
materials.notes: Generic value only; lambda is product-specific and declared to BS EN 13163. Check c and mu against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3 (EPS).

materials.name: Polyisocyanurate (PIR) board, foil faced
materials.notes: Generic value only; lambda is product-specific and declared to BS EN 13165. Facings dominate the vapour resistance, so mu of the core is not the whole story. Check against ISO 10456 and product declarations.

materials.name: Wood fibre insulation board
materials.notes: Generic value only; lambda is product-specific and declared to BS EN 13171. Check c and mu against ISO 10456 and product declarations.

materials.name: Polyethylene vapour control layer
materials.notes: A thin membrane's contribution is its Sd, not its lambda. Check lambda, rho, c against ISO 10456 (polyethylene) and take Sd from the product declaration to BS EN ISO 12572.

materials.name: Bitumen sheet membrane
materials.notes: Check against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3 (bitumen / roofing felt) and take Sd from the product declaration.

materials.name: Concrete roof tile
materials.notes: Check against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3 (tiles, concrete) and BR 443.

materials.name: Clay roof tile
materials.notes: Check against BS EN ISO 10456:2007 Table 3 (tiles, clay) and BR 443.
